caption:
The video showcases a large floor mosaic constructed from thousands of upright dominoes arranged as pixel art on a light wooden surface. The design depicts a yellow wedge of cheese dotted with red holes, set within a blue square field and ringed by a standing multicolored border, while a separate wavy line of flat dominoes lies outside the bordered square along the bottom and right edges. The camera remains fixed on the scene as it begins to collapse.

A collapse starts at the bottom-left corner of the blue field, where standing dominoes tip over into a flattened blue patch. The fallen area expands along the bottom edge toward the center and climbs the left edge, progressively flattening the blue tiles as the front advances. The lower-left pointed tip of the yellow cheese falls, merging into the flattened region. The multicolored border remains upright, while the upper and right portions of the field remain standing.
